The function directly implements the action of deleting a note from a specified cell in a worksheet, as described in the claim text, through its `delete_note` operation.

The function accepts a `path` parameter (workbook path) and a `sheet` parameter (sheet name), which are used to identify and operate on the target worksheet, aligning with the claim's description of operating on a given workbook and sheet.

The function accepts a `path` parameter representing the workbook file path, which is used to access the workbook and its sheets, directly supporting the claim's description of the workbook path input.
The function takes a `sheet` parameter (type `SheetName`) to identify the worksheet within the workbook where the note is located, matching the claim's description of the sheet name input.
